title: DEC-260: Consolidate onto main by landing the slice stack in order (2026-11-01)
text:
- **Problem**: Work sat on 209 local branches and 3 worktrees; main had not moved since #126 (2026-10-08).
- **Options considered**: (A) merge #129 then open a Slice 12 PR; (B) one combined Slice 11+12 PR; (C) keep working on the Slice 12 branch.
- **Decision**: A (owner). #129 squash-merged as 2473ad19. Slice 12 took main by MERGE, not rebase (e8c8755f: final Slice 11 tip; 8987d6d2: -s ours over main, whose tree equals that tip), so no Slice 12 SHA cited by handoffs was rewritten. Draft PR #133 opened. 189 merged branches deleted locally and 70 on GitHub, each archived under refs/archive/branches/ (manifest ~/.codex/archive/branch-archive-20261101.tsv).
- **Downstream**: Work from the main checkout with one branch per slice. Slice 12 uncommitted wave-9 work stays in its owner worktree (backup/s12-wip-20261031).
- **Reversibility**: High (archived refs, backup branch).

title: DEC-261: Merge Slice 11 to main in-progress at 121/122 (2026-11-01)
text:
- **Problem**: #129 was green but a deliberate draft; AC-045 cannot close until #127 (Slice 13) and #128 (Slice 12) resolve.
- **Options considered**: merge now in-progress; keep draft until AC-045 closes; land Slices 11+12 together.
- **Decision**: Merge now (owner), matching the Slice 10 precedent; Slice 11 stays in-progress and unsigned on main. Repository allow_auto_merge enabled (owner) to land it on green.
- **Downstream**: AC-045 closes in a later change once #127/#128 resolve; Phase 2 slice count unchanged.
- **Reversibility**: Low (merged to main).

title: DEC-262: Size CI job limits to the Phase 2 suite (2026-11-01)
text:
- **Problem**: PR #129 CI timed out (quality 45 min, database 30 min) while db:verify alone takes about 51 min; the browser step waited 25.5 of 30 lock minutes behind the database job.
- **Options considered**: rerun unchanged; raise limits; split browser gates into a job that needs database.
- **Decision**: Raise limits: quality 120 min, database 90 min, browser lock wait 60 min (6980e266, e119cc6f). Splitting jobs would change the required-check set.
- **Downstream**: infra/verify-database.sh still waits only 600 s for the lock, so concurrent CI runs collide (BLOCKER-020).
- **Reversibility**: High.

title: PAT-040: Pending schedule fixtures must never come due during a PostgREST run (2026-11-01)
text:
- **Type**: anti-pattern
- **Confidence**: 0.5
- **Context**: tests/postgrest suites share one committed database; sweep suites assert the global claim holds only their own schedules; CMS-03B-07 accepts 60 s..366 d ahead.
- **Pattern**: Never leave a pending schedule at a short Date.now() lead or a fixed calendar date. Use tests/postgrest/support/phase-02-slice-11-fixture-time.ts (>= 6 h ahead, inside the horizon, tz-derived folds).
- **Source**: CI run 41267061612 (+300 s precision fixtures claimed by the sweep-outcomes retry ladder) and a fixed 2026-11-01T05:30Z fold that would fail from 05:29Z.

title: PAT-041: Editing a ledger-cited test file stales its evidence receipts (2026-11-01)
text:
- **Type**: best-practice
- **Confidence**: 0.5
- **Context**: Slice 10+ evidence guards compare each receipt fileSha256 with the cited file.
- **Pattern**: After changing any cited test file, run node scripts/evidence/run-slice-evidence.mjs --slice NN for every slice that cites it and commit the receipts before pushing. Start the Supabase stack first (CI cleanup stops it; the runner only resets). Never hand-patch receipt rows.
- **Source**: CI run 41271472256 (17 stale receipts) and a first regeneration that aborted on a stopped stack.

title: PAT-042: Read origin/main and active worktrees before reporting pipeline status (2026-11-01)
text:
- **Type**: anti-pattern
- **Confidence**: 0.5
- **Context**: The main checkout can lag origin/main by weeks; slice work lives in ~/.codex/worktrees/<lane>/WeJammin.
- **Pattern**: git fetch, compare main with origin/main, git worktree list, and read the newest worktree progress files and handoff STATE.md before stating where the pipeline is.
- **Source**: A status report built from a 29-commit-stale main checkout said Slice 09 was blocked when Slices 09-10 had merged and 11-12 were in progress.

title: BLOCKER-020: Concurrent CI runs collide on the shared Supabase lock (2026-11-01)
text:
- **Status**: active
- **Impact**: All three self-hosted runners share one local Supabase stack. infra/verify-database.sh waits only 600 s for the lock while a database job holds it about 40-55 min, so a second concurrent CI run (another PR, or main after a merge) fails its database job.
- **Resolution**: Open; serialize CI runs (workflow-level concurrency group) or lengthen the database-job lock wait.
